name: SINCLIENT
source:
Tooru lost his memories and roamed the street of Yokohama searching for his identity and past. There were many contacts on his cell phone and his room was full of weapons and fake passports. Men in black suits chased after him and his body instinctively knew how to fight. It was obvious that he was not a normal person before losing his memories.

He also had a room key in his pocket and when he found the hotel and entered the room, he was appalled to find a murdered woman with the word ‘Pigrizia’ written on the wall in blood. This was part of the ‘Seven Deadly Sins’ murders that the public had been abuzz about. Finding a memo on his cell phone that looked like a murder plan, he began to suspect whether he was the serial killer. Then he met a man that looked like the spitting image of himself.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/09/01/september-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
透失去了記憶，在橫濱的街頭遊蕩，尋找自己的身分和過去。他的手機裡有很多聯絡人，房間裡滿是武器和假護照。穿黑西裝的男人追殺他，而他的身體本能地知道如何戰鬥。很明顯，在失去記憶之前他絕不是普通人。

他口袋裡還有一把房間鑰匙，當他找到飯店、走進房間時，震驚地發現一名被殺害的女人，牆上用血寫著「Pigrizia」（懶惰）。這是公眾熱議的「七宗罪」連環謀殺案的一部分。在手機上發現了一份看起來像謀殺計畫的備忘錄後，他開始懷疑自己是否就是那個連環殺手。然後他遇到了一個和自己長得一模一樣的男人。

［來自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/09/01/september-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]］
